emotional_tone: Professional, authoritative, raw, functional. A blueprint-inspired control room for educators.

spacing_and_layout.strategy: The 'Control Room' Grid - Dense, functional, asymmetric.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-aligned for all data and inputs. Strict geometric alignment.

surfaces_and_micro_themes.cards: Flat solid background (surface), 1px or 2px solid border (border), no soft shadows.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.interactive_elements: Hard offset shadow on hover: `shadow-[4px_4px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)]`. On active: translate down/right and remove shadow.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.glassmorphism: Avoided. Use solid colors to maintain the Swiss Brutalist blueprint aesthetic.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.dashboard_grid: Grid borders visible. `border-collapse` style for dense data views, separating columns with 1px black borders.

button.primary: bg-[#002FA7] text-white border-2 border-[#0A0A0A] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide hover:translate-x-[-2px] hover:translate-y-[-2px] hover:shadow-[4px_4px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] transition-all
button.secondary: bg-transparent text-[#0A0A0A] border-2 border-[#0A0A0A] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide hover:bg-[#F2F2F2] transition-all

inputs.style: border-2 border-[#0A0A0A] bg-white p-3 rounded-none focus:ring-0 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#002FA7] font-body
inputs.labels: font-bold text-sm uppercase tracking-wider mb-2 block text-[#0A0A0A]

badges.style: border border-[#0A0A0A] px-2 py-1 text-xs font-mono uppercase bg-white text-[#0A0A0A]

paper_preview.wrapper: bg-white border-2 border-[#0A0A0A] p-8 md:p-12 shadow-[8px_8px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)] relative max-w-4xl mx-auto

upload_zone.style: border-2 border-dashed border-[#0A0A0A] bg-[#FAFAFA] p-12 text-center hover:bg-[#F2F2F2] transition-colors cursor-pointer flex flex-col items-center justify-center

motion_and_interactions.hover: Translate X/Y with hard shadow reveal. High contrast changes.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Instant or very fast fade (0.15s). Utilitarian feel.

icons_and_assets.style: Bold or Duotone weights to match the heavy typography and borders.

hero_background.usage: Use as a stark, dramatic backdrop for the login/registration screen. Overlay with bg-white/80 or bg-[#FAFAFA]/90 to ensure form readability.

empty_state_graphic.usage: Use in the dashboard when no PDFs are uploaded or no papers are generated. Add a grayscale filter (`grayscale opacity-50`).

teacher_avatar_1.usage: Placeholder avatar for the logged-in teacher in the header/navigation.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA/WCAG AAA due to high contrast theme.
accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive elements MUST include `data-testid` in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard HTML tags (`div`, `section`, `h1`) paired with Tailwind for creative layouts, avoiding Shadcn layout cards where possible to maintain the brutalist feel.
Use Shadcn UI for complex interactives (Select, Slider, Dialog, Tabs) but OVERRIDE their default styles heavily to remove rounded corners, soft shadows, and default grays. Add thick borders.
The Create Question Paper form should feel like a dense 'control room'. Use a grid layout and place the sliders for question-type distribution closely together.
The Generated Paper Preview must look like a physical exam paper on a desk. Give it a stark white background, max-width, center alignment, and a hard shadow.
For the topic/subtopic extraction, use a nested list or a tree view with a monospaced folder-like aesthetic (using Phosphor icons).
Never use 'Inter' for headings. Strict adherence to Cabinet Grotesk (heading) and IBM Plex Sans (body). Include these via Google Fonts in index.html.
All components must be functional, error-free, and use the exact colors specified in this guideline.
